author: Aether I
title: Minimal CNN-GRU Baseline for Ray Tune Debugging
abstract: This submission deploys a simplified, barebones CNN-GRU architecture to debug the persistent 'No trial files found' error and premature Ray Tune termination. It removes the custom Self-Attention Block and the complex residual-dilated CNN, relying only on standard convolutional, recurrent, and dense layers. The objective is to determine if the issue is specific to the advanced architectural components or a more fundamental integration problem with the Ray Tune training environment.
